text: dsh-better-quotes 是面向 DSH Web 的消息引用与转发插件。在助手消息操作区点击引用按钮可把整条消息放入输入框，长按或按 Shift+Enter 会打开右侧 Quotes 面板。面板支持搜索并多选当前聊天中可见的用户消息、引导消息和已完成的助手消息，再将它们合并为带会话与序号等身份信息的引用包插入输入框，或转发到另一个本地会话；发送后的引用卡片还能定位回原消息。适合需要在提示中保留消息上下文、整理多条内容或跨会话传递参考材料的 DSH Web 用户。无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-better-quotes adds whole-message quoting to DSH Web. Click to insert an assistant message, or hold to select visible messages in the right sidebar. Insert them as one bundle or forward it to another local session. Sent bundles can locate their source. No API key or external service is needed.
我想把一整条助手回复连同上下文引用到输入框里。
能不能一次选好几条聊天消息，再合并成一个引用？
让 DSH 可以把选中的消息发到另一个本地会话作为参考。
想从引用内容快速跳回原聊天消息并高亮它。
我需要在长对话里搜索消息，然后挑几条放进提示。
如何把另一段会话里的几条消息作为背景材料转给当前任务？
I want to quote a complete assistant message into my draft with its identity preserved.
Can I collect several chat messages into one bundle and send it to another session?
dsh-better-quotes 的功能「单条消息引用」：点击助手消息操作区的引用按钮，会把该消息内容和会话身份信息格式化后插入输入框。
dsh-better-quotes 的功能「多选引用」：长按引用操作或使用 Shift+Enter 打开右侧面板，可搜索并选择可见消息，再将所选消息组合成单个引用包放入输入框。
dsh-better-quotes 的功能「跨会话转发」：在面板中选择目标会话后，可将同一引用包作为参考文本排入该本地会话。
dsh-better-quotes 的功能「返回原消息」：展开已发送的引用卡片并点击其中条目，可滚动到同一会话的源消息并短暂高亮。
dsh-better-quotes 使用当前加载的聊天快照生成可选消息；不可见节点会跳过，助手消息仍在生成或没有最终节点时也不会进入选择列表。
dsh-better-quotes 在引用包中记录附件的身份与属性而不复制附件内容；附件是否仍可读取取决于原会话保留的数据。

dsh-better-quotes README · dsh-better-quotes：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-quotes) [](https://github.com/SpellingDragon/dsh-better-quotes/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE)

**Quote or forward whole messages in DeepSeek Harness Web — one click, one bundle, every identity the model needs.**

dsh-better-quotes README · dsh-better-quotes：Select-to-quote copies text fragments that forget where they came from. This plugin quotes the *whole message* — user, steering, or assistant — together with its sender, time, identity, model route, skills, references, and attachments, wrapped in one bounded bundle the model can read and look up again.

dsh-better-quotes README · Features：- **One control, two outcomes.** Click the quote icon between Copy and Fork to quote that message immediately; hold it (or press `Shift+Enter`) to open multi-select. The transcript gains no extra checkboxes or toolbars.
- **Whole-message multi-select.** Pick any user, steering, and finalized assistant messages from the right-Sidebar **Quotes** tab. The transcript never scrolls, blanks, or gets covered while you choose.
- **Durable metadata.** Every quoted message carries sender role, time, `session_id`, `seq`, `message_id`, provider/model, loaded skills, `@session` references, and image/file attachments with names, sizes, and dimensions.
- **One bounded bundle.** A single `<quoted_messages>` envelope replaces N disconnected blockquotes — the model reads the quote as context and can query the original events by identity.
- **Cross-session forwarding.** Send the same bundle to any other local Session as non-instruction reference context, from the same panel.
- **Click to locate.** Sent bundle cards start folded; clicking an item scrolls to the source and highlights it, unfolding collapsed process groups first. Cards from other sessions say so and h

dsh-better-quotes README · Quick start：```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-better-quotes-0.5.0.tgz

From a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm dsh plugin` instead of `dsh plugin`. Restart `dsh web` or refresh the browser. The package targets DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`.

Once published to npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-quotes
```

dsh-better-quotes README · Quote one message：Click the icon between Copy and Fork. The message enters the composer immediately, matching the official select-to-quote interaction. The quote chip shows a one-line summary — quoted count and message previews — and carries the bundle inside the same quote.

dsh-better-quotes README · Quote or forward several：1. Hold the same icon for half a second, or press `Shift+Enter`.
2. The Quotes tab opens in the right Sidebar with that message selected, its list starting at the newest messages. Click rows to toggle selection, search to narrow the list, and use the single all/none control for what is shown.
3. Choose **Insert quote (N)** to place one bundle in the composer, or **Forward** to pick another local Session and send the same bundle. Either action collapses the Sidebar when it completes.
4. The target excludes the current Session and subagent Sessions.

dsh-better-quotes README · Locate：Sent bundle cards start folded. Expand one and click a same-Session item to scroll to the rendered original and briefly highlight it. Folded process groups are expanded first. Forwarded cards show **From another session** and hide source navigation.

dsh-better-quotes README · Bundle format：One insert creates one envelope; the composer draft prefixes the summary line its quote chip shows, and once sent the card owns that line so the transcript shows only the card:

```xml
<quoted_messages version="1" source_session="…" count="2">
<quoted_message role="user" time="2026-10-26T04:05:06.789Z" seq="12" message_id="…" session_id="…">
<metadata>
<skill name="pdf" />

dsh-better-quotes README · Bundle format：`session_id` + `seq` let the model read the original event with `session_event_read`; `message_id` is omitted when the host does not expose one. `<skill>` and `<reference>` record loaded skills and `@session` labels. `[attachment …]` records durable image/file ids, names, sizes, media types, and dimensions. Literal boundary tags in message text are escaped.

dsh-better-quotes README · Bundle format：Attachments are referenced, not copied. If history compaction removes the original, image pixels may be unavailable; files remain readable only while their saved path is in history.

dsh-better-quotes README · Model lookup：Mount the optional session query tools when the model should read source events:

```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-session-query'
```

The bundle remains readable without it, but cannot be queried by identity.

dsh-better-quotes README · Compatibility and privacy：- `insertQuote` is used when the host exposes it; older hosts fall back to `insertText` at the caret.
- The selector reads the Chat snapshot through standard Session props; it does not scrape the DOM.
- Forwarding stays inside the local DSH process and only targets Sessions the client lists.
- No external HTTP requests, analytics, or remote services.
- All text is React-rendered; stylesheet classes are prefixed `bq-`.

dsh-better-quotes README · How it compares：| Plugin | Selection entry | Quote shape | Cross-Session forwarding | Durable identity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **dsh-better-quotes** | One action: click quotes, hold multi-selects in the right Sidebar | One bounded `<quoted_messages>` bundle | Yes, same tab | `session_id`, `seq`, `message_id`, time, route, skills, references |
| [dsh-message-forward](https://github.com/Domaki-co/dsh-message-forward) | Long-press multi-select; forward dialog | Forwarding context | Yes | Source session and speaker |
| [dsh-quote-followup](https://github.com/tr1v3r/dsh-quote-followup) | Selection toolbar; text | Quote chips | No | Text selection |
| [dsh-select-quote](https://github.com/latte03/dsh-select-quote) | Selection toolbar; text | Stacked cards | No | Text selection |
| [dsh-quote-annotate-pro](https://github.com/zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro) | Selection toolbar; text and annotations | Anchored quote blocks | No | Turn/role anchors |
| [dsh-multi-selection-comments](https://github.com/yuanc1204/dsh-multi-selection-comments) | Selection toolbar; multiple text segments | Structured context | No | Segments and comments |

dsh-better-quotes README · Design：- One control carries two outcomes: click quotes immediately; hold opens multi-select.
- Multi-select is a `sidebar.right.pane.tab` body, so the transcript stays put while selecting.
- The panel is one transaction: an action collapses the Sidebar, and re-entering starts the list at the newest messages.
- One bundle replaces N disconnected quotes and carries source, count, order, and per-message boundaries.
- Bundle cards start folded; clicking an item is the locate affordance.
- Locate unfolds a folded process group and drives the real vertical scrollport.

flowchart LR
  A[Click] --> B[formatBundle]
  B --> C[insertQuote / insertText]
  A2[Hold] --> D[Quotes tab]

dsh-better-quotes README · Limitations and roadmap：- Multi-select lives in the right Sidebar, not as per-row checkboxes in the transcript.
- Locate only works inside the source Session.
- Attachments are referenced, not re-attached; thumbnails and re-attachment remain future work.
- Only the loaded, visible Chat window is listed.
- No browser E2E or GIF yet.

dsh-better-quotes README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

- `QuoteAction.tsx` — click quote / hold multi-select.
- `QuoteDrawer.tsx` and `QuoteRow.tsx` — right-Sidebar selector and message rows.
- `bundle.ts`, `quote-rule.ts`, `BundleQuote.tsx` — bundle format, parsing, and card.
- `locate.ts` — unfold and source locate.
- `tests/` — 41 focused tests.
